description: This file manages the registration and unregistration of a service worker for a Progressive Web App (PWA), including handling localhost detection, environment checks, and service worker lifecycle events.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the service worker if in production environment and not on localhost, setting up update and success callbacks.

methods.name: registerValidSW
methods.description: Handles the registration of the service worker and manages update events.

methods.name: checkValidServiceWorker
methods.description: Checks if the service worker script exists and is valid; unregisters and reloads if not.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the service worker if supported.
